pulse_energy_on_sample.note: e^-2 area ~0.3 mm^2; peak intensity ~100 W cm^-2 (two-photon processes negligible); ~1e-4 of light absorbed in the monolayer

source.evidence: The laser impinged normal onto the sample surface

incidence_angle.note: For fused-silica-supported samples irradiation from the back side was intended (§2.2); per-sample geometry not reported.

excitation.polarization_optics: zero-order quarter-wave plate after half-wave plate + Glan-Laser polarizer; linear = s-polarized; 10 mm fused-silica UHV windows, no birefringence measured

source.evidence: direction of circular polarization is defined relative to the spin quantization axis

ellipticity.note: polarization 'carefully characterized using a second polarizer' but no ellipticity value given

source.evidence: accelerated toward a scattering target at +50 kV

qualitative_findings.claim: Sign of P follows helix handedness: (P) duplexes give positive P (spin parallel to momentum), (M) give negative P, for both dsPNA and γPNA-PNA.
For all functionalized surfaces P is independent of light polarization within error margins.
Maximum |P| in γPNA-PNA (with 3 chiral γ-monomers) is 2-3x higher than in unmodified dsPNA; correlates with ~4x larger CD magnitude.
Handedness-spin relation is opposite to right-handed dsDNA, oligopeptide α-helices and overcrowded alkenes, but same as heptahelicene and bacteriorhodopsin.
Measured P varied by as much as 30% over the surface area of the γPNA-PNA monolayer; reduced values attributed to monolayer imperfections.
Spin polarization per length is roughly doubled in γPNA-PNA vs dsDNA (dsDNA ~2-3 %/nm for 26-78 bp); unmodified dsPNA ~half as efficient as dsDNA per length.

discrepancies.description: Main text: S = 0.18 (in P formula). SI S3: S_eff = -0.18. Stored SI signed value per schema rule.
Text reads '±25% for cw and cw circularly polarized light ... respectively' (typo); ccw assignment of -25% inferred.
Abstract: P in PNA lacking chiral monomers 'about P = 12%' corresponds to (P) dsPNA 11.6%; (M) dsPNA gave only -7.3%. Abstract 'up to 24.4%' refers to linear light; cw on same spot gave 26.1 ± 4.2%.
SI S4 says 'at least two measurements' per sample; only two positions are reported per sample.
Ellipsometry (n=6), XPS and UPS specimens are not stated to be the specimens measured by Mott polarimetry; values are attached at sample-type level.
Pitch/bp-per-turn/rise are literature dsγPNA homoduplex values used as proxy for the γPNA-PNA hybrid (3 of 20 monomers modified); recorded with basis = literature_proxy_molecule.
